highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.1 collects rendering and Vulkan synchronization corrections while retaining Skia m156.
highlights_body: The collected fixes improve transformed geometry, displacement sampling and GPU flush handling without changing managed APIs.

bullets.lead: More accurate transformed shapes and filters
bullets.detail: Corrects ellipse and rounded-rectangle stroke transforms, clamps corner radii to prevent overlap, and uses float-precision displacement offsets to match filter bounds.

bullets.lead: Safer GPU flush and clip recording
bullets.detail: Prevents stale atlas work after empty Ganesh flushes. Graphite counts pending clips against pass capacity and warns and skips a draw whose clip stack cannot fit a fresh pass.
Synchronous native submission now accounts for fence-wait failures. GRContext.Submit remains void: this does not add a managed failure result or exception, and asynchronous submission is unchanged.
